2607.09487.title: Neural Collapse Is Forbidden: Information Floors in Language Models
2607.09487.paper_summary: Within-class variance in language-model representations is commonly read as incomplete neural collapse. We argue it is allocated information storage, and that the allocation obeys a law. A one-line centering identity voids a family of simplex equiangular-tight-frame claims, including our own earlier ones; in dimensionless variance shares across 14 models, macro-category structure carries only 4-12% of representational variance and within-token context carries 79-91%, stable across a 100x parameter range. On the theory side, token-level weight decay penalizes a category in proportion to its type count, not its occurrence mass, reducing next-token prediction to an imbalanced K-class problem whose optimum orders category norms by type count. A converse floor, proved for binary categories, forces within-category dispersion to be at least proportional to the conditional mutual information I(token; context | category). The law holds: identity dispersion, not total variance, tracks this information across every tested model and partition, under a model-free estimate and even across models, where one model's information predicts another's dispersion; and over pretraining the category share overshoots, decays, and partially recovers, because the information it must carry never left.
2607.09487.paper_summary_zh: 班內語言模型表示的變異性通常被解讀為不完全的神經崩潰。<lb/>我們認為這是分配的信息儲存，且該分配遵循一條法則。<lb/>一個單行的中心化身份使一系列簡單的等角緊框主張失效，包括我們之前的主張；在14個模型的無量綱變異性份額中，宏類別結構僅攜帶4-12%的表示變異性，而內部標記上下文攜帶79-91%，在100倍的參數範圍內保持穩定。<lb/>在理論方面，標記級別的權重衰減根據類別的類型數量而非其出現量來懲罰一個類別，將下一標記的預測簡化為一個不平衡的K類問題，其最佳解按類型數量排序類別的範數。<lb/>對於二元類別，已證明的反向下限迫使類別內的離散度至少與條件互信息I(token; context | category)成比例。<lb/>這條法則成立：身份離散度，而非總變異性，跟踪這一信息，適用於每個測試過的模型和分區，根據無模型的估計，甚至在不同模型之間，其中一個模型的信息預測另一個模型的離散度；而在預訓練過程中，類別份額超過、衰減並部分恢復，因為它必須攜帶的信息從未消失。
2607.09487.author: Bruno Abrahao et.al.
